choices.text: Close your eyes and say nothing

effects.log: It is quickly done. It is a very long time before it is over.

effects.log: {npc} is quiet. Then {he} asks what you want them to believe. It is the first thing you have planned together in years.

"If you read them," {he} says, "you know I wrote well." You did. It is fine work. You never knew {he} thought so of you.

effects.log: {npc} reads it under the lamp. {He} corrects one word. {ssp_contact} will have a very bad year.

effects.log: {npc} takes it. {He} is halfway down the lane before you trust your legs.

effects.log: The pier is empty at this hour. It was always a quiet pier.

effects.log: No one breathes. {npc} squares the slips, because they were crooked, and goes.

effects.log: You give them a little time to leave the room. Not all of them take it.

You have not brewed in this pavilion in decades and you take your time. You set a cup before {him} and sit down opposite. {He} lifts it by habit, smells it, stops, and looks up.

effects.log: {npc} watches you climb with it. {He} stays in the hall a long while before following.

effects.log: {npc} blinks. Something stirs behind {his} eyes that you have not seen since your first season together.

effects.log: {npc} sets the last crescent on the plate, wipes {his} hands, and goes.

choices.text: Take the darning from {his} hands

effects.log: {npc} lets you. {He} looks almost relieved. It is the last thing you will ever know of {him}.

events.text: You name {ssp_contact} over supper, and every new moon for a year, and {npc} keeps ladling the stew. "Yes," {he} says. "I wondered when." {He} has thought on this. {He} recites, in order, each time you looked past {him} before someone who mattered, with the place and the year. "They look at me when I speak," {he} says. "Say what you will of them. They do look."

choices.text: Put down your spoon, and look at {him}

effects.log: You do. It is a strange thing to do to a person after so long. {npc} looks back. Neither of you eats. It is a beginning, or near to one.

choices.text: Ask what they would believe, coming from {him}

effects.log: {npc} stops ladling. {He} looks at you properly, and starts to think. You had forgotten how well {he} did that.

choices.text: Tell {him} to go and be looked at, then

effects.log: {npc} sets down the ladle, unties {his} apron, folds it, and goes.

choices.text: Send the servants away from the table

effects.log: They go. The stew goes cold. By morning the whole lane knows what became of it, and you tell them so yourself.

events.text: You have nothing but a feeling, and you say it anyway, and {npc} stares. Then {his} eyes fill. All these years, {he} says, and this is what you think. By morning the household knows you accused {him} of something, none can say what, and they are all very gentle with {him}. You feel a fool. You are also, you notice, a little more closely watched.

choices.text: Apologise, before them all

effects.log: You apologise. {npc} forgives you beautifully, before everyone. It takes you some time to see what that cost you.

mem.note: apologised in front of the whole house, and meant none of it

choices.text: Say nothing, and start looking properly

effects.log: You should have begun there. You begin there.

events.text: It takes three nights. The first, {npc} lets you talk. The second, {he} tells you what it has been, and you had no idea, and say so. The third, {he} goes into the back room and returns with a small bag: a phial, an account book, a list of names. What it was going to be. "I had not decided," {he} says. "I wish you to know that I had not decided."

choices.text: Burn it together

effects.log: It burns slowly in the hearth. You both watch to the end. Nobody says anything clever.

choices.text: Keep it, and say you will never need to open it

effects.log: {npc} looks at you. Then {he} nods slowly. It goes on a high shelf. It is still there.

events.text: You have only been coming home. The small things have ceased: the sweet voice, the careful questions, whatever it was you half saw. {npc} laughs at supper again, at something you said, and stops, and regards you as if {he} has set down a weight you never knew of. "What?" you say. "Nothing," {he} says, and passes the bread. "Eat."

choices.text: Eat

effects.log: You eat. You will never know how close it was. It is a good supper.

choices.text: Ask {him} what {he} was going to say

effects.log: {npc} thinks. "Later," {he} says. "When we are old." {He} is smiling.

events.text: {npc} waited a year to ask, and has plainly been practising. Did {ssp_who} truly do what they say? And did it have to end as it did? {He} is not weeping. You would prefer it. {He} asks across the practice yard, back very straight, standing exactly as you stand when someone has hurt you. You had not noticed {he} learned that.

choices.text: Tell {him} all of it, your part first

effects.log: {npc} listens to the end, nods, and returns to the forms. {He} is not the same with you after. {He} does trust you, though.

mem.note: told me all of it, even their own part

choices.text: Say {he} will understand when {he} is older

effects.log: {npc} nods politely. It is the politeness {ssp_who} used. You feel it go in.

mem.note: would not tell me the truth about my own parent

events.text: You would know that walk anywhere, even across a crowded market square. {npc} halts at a courteous distance. {He} has done well. It shows in the boots. "I heard what they say of you," {he} says. "I did not begin most of it. I wished you to know the difference." The square flows around you. You were wed to this person. You can still tell when {he} lies, and {he} does not.

choices.text: Say it is over, then, and wish {him} well

effects.log: {npc} regards you a moment longer, then laughs, the true laugh, and goes. You find you meant it.

choices.text: Say that next time you will not leave the gate open

effects.log: {npc} bows exactly as deep as is polite. It is good to know where you stand. Somewhere over the border your name goes back on a list.

events.text: You are both old enough now to sit in the sun, and from nowhere {npc} says: that was the winter I nearly finished you. {He} tells you all of it then: the day {he} came nearest, what stopped {him}, and what it was truly about, which is not what you thought. {He} is shelling beans the whole while. "I thought you should have it," {he} says. "Before one of us forgets."

choices.text: Take the other half of the beans

effects.log: You shell them together. There is nothing to add. It is the longest you have gone without wanting to speak.

choices.text: Say you always knew

effects.log: You did not. {npc} knows you did not. {He} smiles and lets you have it, which is how you know {he} has forgiven you as well.

choices.text: Go inside

effects.log: You go inside. You do not come out for a while. {He} finishes the beans alone.
